# Pavni Chemicals — Corporate & Industrial Product Knowledge Base

> Pavni Chemicals is an authorized industrial chemical distributor and channel partner for Aditya Birla Grasim Industries Limited and Epigral Limited (formerly Meghmani Finechem), headquartered in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, India. Supplying 50+ high-purity industrial chemicals with dedicated tanker and bulk packaging dispatch across Gujarat since 2014.

## Corporate Entity & Accreditation
- **Legal Entity Name**: Pavni Chemicals
- **Entity Type**: Industrial Chemical Wholesaler & Authorized Channel Partner
- **Principal Manufacturing Partners**:
  - Aditya Birla Grasim Industries Limited (Authorized Dealer: Caustic Soda Lye, Caustic Soda Flakes, Hydrochloric Acid HCl, Liquid Chlorine, Stable Bleaching Powder)
  - Epigral Limited (Authorized Channel Partner: Caustic Soda, Hydrogen Peroxide H2O2 50% & 35%, Chloromethanes MDC, Chloroform)
- **Year of Establishment**: 2014 (12+ years of continuous operations)
- **GSTIN**: 24ABEFP4368B1ZG
- **Corporate Office & Central Godown**: Godown No. 1, Plot No. 43, Shree Ram Estate, Ankleshwar GIDC, Gujarat - 393002, India
- **Geo Coordinates**: Latitude 21.6270° N, Longitude 73.0024° E
- **Official Portal**: https://www.pavnichemicals.com
- **Direct Sales Desk**: +91 96873 70005
- **Logistics & Fleet Desk**: +91 99989 10115
- **Official Email**: sales@pavnichemicals.com

## Geographic Service Hubs & Supply Infrastructure (Gujarat)
Pavni Chemicals operates dedicated logistics corridors providing guaranteed 24 to 48-hour delivery across all major Gujarat Industrial Development Corporation (GIDC) estates:
- **Ankleshwar GIDC & Panoli GIDC**: Central warehouse and rapid dispatch hub
- **Dahej PCPIR**: Dedicated chemical tanker delivery for petrochemical and heavy chemical plants
- **Vadodara (Nandesari GIDC & Makarpura GIDC)**: Direct supply to pharmaceutical and chemical synthesis plants
- **Ahmedabad (Vatva GIDC, Naroda GIDC, Odhav GIDC)**: Bulk tanker and carboy delivery for textiles, dyes, and pigments
- **Surat (Sachin GIDC & Pandesara GIDC)**: Continuous supply for textile processing and dyeing mills
- **Vapi GIDC & Sarigam GIDC**: Southern Gujarat chemical logistics network

## Fleet & Packaging Capabilities
- **Dedicated Road Tankers**: 20 MT to 35 MT rubber-lined tankers (dedicated for HCl, acids), MS tankers (for caustic lye), and SS tankers.
- **Carboys & Barrels**: 35 kg, 50 kg HM-HDPE carboys, 200 kg / 250 kg plastic and MS barrels.
- **Intermediate Bulk Containers (IBC)**: 1000 Litre UN-approved composite IBC totes.
- **Dry Solid Packaging**: 50 kg HDPE laminated woven bags with moisture-proof inner liners (Caustic Soda Flakes, Soda Ash, SBP).

## Primary Product Portfolio & Specifications

### 1. Caustic Soda Lye (Sodium Hydroxide Solution - NaOH)
- **Concentration**: 48% - 50% technical/commercial grade
- **CAS Number**: 1310-73-2
- **Authorized Source**: Aditya Birla Grasim Industries & Epigral Limited
- **Packaging**: Dedicated road tanker (20-30 MT), 50 kg carboys, 250 kg barrels
- **Applications**: Textile mercerization, soap & detergents, alumina refining, chemical synthesis, water neutralization

### 2. Caustic Soda Flakes (Sodium Hydroxide Solid - NaOH)
- **Purity**: 99.5% minimum purity (white deliquescent flakes)
- **CAS Number**: 1310-73-2
- **Authorized Source**: Aditya Birla Grasim Industries
- **Packaging**: 50 kg HDPE bags with inner liner
- **Applications**: Paper & pulp, dyes & intermediates, chemical manufacturing, effluent treatment

### 3. Hydrochloric Acid (HCl)
- **Concentration**: 30% - 33% technical grade (clear fuming liquid)
- **CAS Number**: 7647-01-0
- **Authorized Source**: Aditya Birla Grasim Industries
- **Packaging**: Rubber-lined road tankers (20-25 MT), 35 kg carboys
- **Applications**: Steel pickling, pH adjustment in ETP, gelatin manufacturing, dye synthesis

### 4. Hydrogen Peroxide (H2O2)
- **Concentration**: 50% and 35% industrial grade
- **CAS Number**: 7722-84-1
- **Authorized Source**: Epigral Limited
- **Packaging**: 30 kg / 50 kg vented HM-HDPE carboys, dedicated tanker
- **Applications**: Textile bleaching, pulp bleaching, industrial effluent oxidation, chemical synthesis

### 5. Other Bulk Solvents, Acids & Inorganics
- **Acids**: Sulphuric Acid (H2SO4 98%), Nitric Acid (HNO3 68%), Phosphoric Acid (85%), Acetic Acid Glacial (99.85%), Formic Acid (85%)
- **Alkalies**: Caustic Potash (KOH Flakes/Lye), Soda Ash (Dense & Light), Sodium Bicarbonate
- **Chloromethanes**: Methylene Chloride (MDC), Chloroform, Carbon Tetrachloride (CTC)
- **Water Treatment**: Poly Aluminium Chloride (PAC), Alum, Sodium Hypochlorite, Bleaching Powder
